girdi.command: ls -R core/ | head -60 && echo "=== AGENTS ===" && cat AGENTS.md
girdi.description: List core tree and read AGENTS.md

girdi.command: grep -n "^function \|^const .*=.*=>\|module.exports" core/hooks/lib.js | head -80; echo "=== LOC ==="; wc -l core/hooks/lib.js

grep -n "^function \(file\|sum\|handle\)\|^function short\|^function lastText\|^function job\|^const LEDGER\|^function items\|^function transcript\|^function entries\|^function turn\|^function prompt\|^function audit" core/hooks/count.js core/hooks/defter.js core/hooks/kitap.js core/hooks/mod.js
girdi.description: Locate helper functions in sibling modules

girdi.command: sed -n '10,30p;120,140p;238,255p' core/hooks/count.js; echo "=== DEFTER short ==="; sed -n '145,215p' core/hooks/defter.js

grep -n "jobs-\|sira-\|stateFile(" core/hooks/mod.js core/hooks/defter.js | head -20; echo "=== items ==="; sed -n '200,225p' core/hooks/mod.js; echo "=== audit ==="; sed -n '120,160p' core/hooks/kitap.js
